vocab.fa: امشب چه برنامه‌ای روی آنتن است؟

vocab.w: Is there anything on TV tonight?

exercises.instr: You are watching TV with a friend. What could you say in each of the situations below?
exercises.instrFa: با دوستت تلویزیون تماشا می‌کنی. در هر موقعیت زیر چه می‌گویی؟

items.en: 1 You want to watch a programme on TV. Could you ________?
opts: Could you turn the TV on?

items.en: 2 You can't hear the programme very well. Could you ________?
3 You want to watch a different programme. Could you ________?
4 Now it's too loud for you. Could you ________?
items.fa: حالا برای تو خیلی بلند است.

items.en: 5 You don't want to watch any more. Could you ________?

exercises.instr: Here are the evening programmes on three British TV channels. Find one example of: a documentary; a quiz show; a game show; a drama series; a current affairs programme. There is also one comedy series, and two soap operas. Can you guess what they are?
exercises.instrFa: این برنامه‌های شبانه سه شبکه تلویزیونی بریتانیاست. یک نمونه از هر کدام پیدا کن.

exercises.instr: Complete these dialogues in a suitable way.
exercises.instrFa: این دیالوگ‌ها را به شکل مناسب کامل کن.

items.en: 1 A: What's ________ TV tonight? B: Oh, the usual soap ________ and stuff like that.
items.fa: امشب چه برنامه‌ای روی آنتن است؟

items.en: 2 A: Did you see the game live? B: No, they just showed the recorded ________
3 A: Ally McBeal is ________ tonight. B: Yes, it's a good programme, but I've seen it before: it's a ________

exercises.instr: Answer these questions about TV in your own country.
exercises.instrFa: به این سؤالات درباره تلویزیون در کشور خودت پاسخ بده.

items.en: 1 How many channels approximately can you watch?
2 Do you watch a lot of satellite TV and/or cable TV?
items.fa: زیاد تلویزیون ماهواره‌ای و/یا کابلی تماشا می‌کنی؟

items.en: 3 In total, how much TV do you watch every week?
items.fa: در کل هر هفته چقدر تلویزیون می‌بینی؟

items.en: 4 What are your favourite programmes on TV at the moment? When are they on?
items.fa: الان برنامه‌های محبوبت در تلویزیون کدام‌اند؟ چه ساعتی پخش می‌شوند؟

items.en: 5 Do you enjoy watching the commercials?
